standards.applies_because: Li-ion pack shipped with the product
EMC emissions of the BLDC motor drive in a residential environment
Only if an app link (BLE/Wi-Fi) is added

risks.risk: High-speed BLDC motor (≈100k rpm) overheats when the airway clogs
risks.mitigation: Motor NTC + current derating, bypass valve, clog detection in firmware
Protected 6S pack with BMS, fuse, IEC 62133-2 cells, drop-tested pack housing

risks.risk: Cyclone separation too weak → filter clogs, suction falls
risks.mitigation: CFD/bench iterations of cyclone cone, washable HEPA post-filter

risks.risk: Hair wrap on the brush bar

risks.mitigation: Motor mount decoupling, exhaust silencer foam

tests.name: Temperature rise and abnormal operation (blocked inlet)
tests.method: Run with the inlet blocked until steady state

tests.name: Drop test of the handheld unit and pack
tests.method: Drop from specified height onto hardwood

tests.name: Suction power / air watts
tests.method: Orifice-plate air-watt curve on the bench

steps: Bench the motor + cyclone in an SLA clear print, measure the air-watt curve
Print the body in MJF PA12
Drive the BLDC motor from an off-the-shelf ESC first, then the quick-turn PCBA
Use a bought-in protected 6S pack for the prototype
Blocked-inlet thermal test before any user test
